    AI Overview
    Yes, the U.S. stock market (NYSE and Nasdaq) is
    closed on Good Friday (April 3, 2026). It is a traditional trading holiday, not a federal holiday. Markets will reopen for normal trading hours on Monday, April 6, 2026. 
    Key 2026 Good Friday Details: 
    • Bond Market: Closes early at 12 p.m. ET on Friday, April 3.
    • Banks/Post Office: Generally open.
    • Futures Markets: CME Globex and other futures markets are closed.
    • Foreign Markets: Some European markets may be closed, while others may be open. 
    Note: For official market hours and holiday calendars, refer directly to the NYSE or Nasdaq websites.
